topic.angle: Training as many small steps downhill on the error

card.title: How a network learns from its errors

panels.text: A neural network is made of connections with weights. The strength of each connection is a weight, and training adjusts them.
The network produces outputs, and training compares them with the target values. The gap is the error that training tries to shrink.
The gradient shows which way the error rises fastest. So training steps the other way, the direction of steepest descent.
Backpropagation works out the gradient with respect to the weights, layer by layer from the output back. Repeat with many small steps, and the error shrinks toward a local minimum.

probes.question: In gradient descent, which way does each step go?
options: In the direction of the gradient

probes.question: True or false: backpropagation efficiently computes the gradient of the loss with respect to the network weights.

claims.claim: Connection strength is a weight, adjusted during training
claims.quote: The strength of the signal at each connection is determined by a weight

claims.claim: Training compares network output with desired output; the gap is the error to minimise
claims.quote: tries to minimize the average squared error between the network's output and the desired output

claims.claim: Moving along the gradient increases the function, i.e. the gradient points uphill
claims.quote: stepping in the direction of the gradient will lead to a trajectory that maximizes that function

claims.claim: Steps go opposite the gradient, the direction of steepest descent (probe 1)
claims.quote: take repeated steps in the opposite direction of the gradient (or approximate gradient) of the function at the current point

claims.claim: Backpropagation computes the gradient with respect to the weights (probe 2)
claims.quote: Backpropagation efficiently computes the gradient of the loss with respect to the network weights

claims.claim: Backpropagation works layer by layer from the output back
claims.quote: propagating derivatives backward, one layer at a time, from the output layer to the input layer

claims.claim: Repeated steps shrink the error toward a local minimum
claims.quote: we want to move against the gradient, toward the local minimum
